title: Eqiom to cut 50 jobs at Rochefort-sur-Nenon cement plant
summary: Eqiom to cut 50 jobs at Rochefort-sur-Nenon cement plant
body_markdown: **France:** Eqiom plans to cut 50 jobs at its Rochefort-sur-Nenon cement plant, reducing its workforce from 77 to 27, as part of a restructuring prompted by declining cement demand and lower profitability. The CRH subsidiary will invest €6.5m in activated clay production to manufacture lower-carbon cement, with production due to start in 2028. The company plans to begin negotiations on a job protection plan on 1 December 2026, aiming to reach an agreement in the first quarter of 2027.
